trace_archive.encoding: NumPy compressed numeric arrays, allow_pickle=False; keys case/field
trace_archive.semantics: Post-physics 200Hz state; pre-step 50Hz Actor input/action; terminal physics rows before automatic reset. Control force getter recomputes clamped force, not measured integration impulse.

criteria.oscillation: At least 40% reduction of settled leg dq RMS and body roll/pitch angular-speed RMS versus nominal, without average height loss > 0.04 m. Continuous values retained.
criteria.support: No terminal failure, persistent nonwheel forces >1 N for >0.1 s, or persistent modeled clearance < -0.02 m; inspect any crossing rather than label it measured penetration.

metric_notes.spectrum: Demean, Hann, rFFT; aggregate per-channel power; near25 band24–26Hz (Actor clipped at Nyquist25); no claim above Nyquist.
metric_notes.period_two: Absolute mean of demeaned issued leg actions times (-1)^tick over policy interval2s through case end.
metric_notes.joint_margin: Name order is 12 P leg joints; continuous wheel angles have no finite position margin.
metric_notes.clip: Issued actions at +/-1, not unobservable raw pre-clipping magnitudes.
metric_notes.forces: Current-state recomputed Genesis control-force getter, not integration impulse or measured motor torque; differs from PhysX pre-step implicit force estimate.
metric_notes.settling: Initial0–2 and settled2–10 separate. Sequence2–10 includes movement; forward uses5–8, stop8–14 and final12–14.
metric_notes.support: Ground-only summed wheel |Fz|, modeled finite cylinder envelope; negative clearance is not a measured penetration.

diagnosis.limit: Establishes an armature dependency of this Genesis closed loop. Does not prove sole PhysX cause, hardware inertia, transfer success, broader robustness or training necessity.
diagnosis.measured_counterpart_not_run: Enough evidence for next matched PhysX comparison; no armature search or additional native run.
diagnosis.historical_model_warning: Measured model also changes camera frames/inertials and tire radius0.086->0.09167m. This comparison cannot isolate camera mass.

recommended_PhysX_mapping.trial: One matched PhysX armature A/B on ORIGINAL: fresh 10 s exact-zero frozen-Actor rollouts at 0.0 and 0.1 kg m^2 on all 16 actuated joints; every other setting identical. Historical measured-asset PhysX nominal is context only.
recommended_PhysX_mapping.required: Verify PhysX effective armature readback by joint name; preserve implicit actuators, Actor, original asset, gains, targets, history and ground. Use API SI units; no USD gain conversion on API values or armature.
recommended_PhysX_mapping.uncertainty: Matching these parameters does not equate Genesis approximate_implicitfast/Newton/contact integration to PhysX implicit drive/solver.
